lll. MILITARY SERVICE

1. Inducted into the United States Army in 1943. Served 3 1/2 years.

2. Veteran of World War Il, having served in the Aleutian Island Theater as a supply clerk and
in the South Pacific Theater as an Infantry Combat Officer. Served also, as a Motor
Maintenance Officer of the Second Major Port at Manila in the Philippines under the

command of the late General Douglas MacArthur.

IV, PROFESSIONAL SERVICE

ar Retired Principal of the Southport Middle School.

2. Administrator and Supervisor of a Federal Education Program for World War II Veterans in
Brunswick County.
3 Organized and carried on an innovative community education program designed to eliminate

poverty in Brunswick County through a Credit Union of 385 members. The Credit Union
made over $150,000,000 worth of loans to low income families.

4. Served as Teacher Trainer in the Teacher-Training program of the N.C. & A.&T. State
College.

5; Served as field consultant to the State Department of Occupational Education and has
contributed to several curriculum guides and discussions of Educational Policy in the State

Department of Instruction.

6. Served as a Board Member of the Brunswick Community College Foundation and set up a
lucrative Endowment Scholarship in honor of my deceased wife, Mrs. Annie E. Francis for

the functional handicapped.

is Member of the National Retired Teachers Association.

4 1. Past president of the North Carolina Vocational Association.
2. Past president of the North Carolina Association of Agriculture Teachers.
3: Retired Secretary-Treasurer of the N.C. Association of Vocational Educators, Inc.
